name: unpause_project
description:
Unpause a paused project by its project ID. Unpausing re-enables automatic assignment of custom production domains and unblocks the active Production Deployment.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} project resume {projectName}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
